name: olio.cb.poem
label: Poem
description: A poem for ChapBook: stores the poem text (via data.directory's content/text field from data.note likeInherits), plus LLM-extracted theme/mood/keywords.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The full poem text. likeInherits from data.note is metadata-only, so this field is declared explicitly.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: LLM-identified dominant theme. Null until analyzePoemTheme runs.

fields.name: mood
fields.description: LLM-identified emotional mood. Fed into landscape prompt as mood parameter.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated imagery keywords extracted by LLM. Optionally enriches the SD prompt.
